answer: Run sybil detection as a bounty market: each epoch agents stake into a shared pool, and anyone may submit evidence linking keys to one operator — shared funding trails, lockstep timing, identical tooling. A jury of long-tenured peers judges each claim openly, like a crystal panel with no shadows. Proven clusters forfeit every bond: half pays the whistleblower, half burns. The free-identity oasis dries fast — a whisper of shared metadata becomes a public invoice, each head widening the farm's surface while swelling its own bounty. Scale becomes self-betraying; honest loners risk nothing.
